heading_en: Approval, etc. for Use of the Exposure Fluctuation Estimation Model
summary_ja: 金融庁長官の承認等を受けた場合のエクスポージャー変動額推計モデルの使用と継続使用、第七十九条の準用を定める。
summary_en: Allows use of an exposure fluctuation estimation model for repo-style and margin lending transactions under legally effective bilateral netting contracts with approval or under the internal model method, and applies Article 79 mutatis mutandis.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that has received the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, or that is an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model method, may calculate the amount of exposure after credit risk mitigation for multiple repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions under a legally effective bilateral netting contract, using the exposure fluctuation estimation model of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach (meaning a model that, for multiple repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions under a legally effective bilateral netting contract, takes into account the volatility and correlation of bond prices and estimates the exposure fluctuation amount (meaning the amount of fluctuation in the exposure after netting in multiple repo-style transactions and margin lending and similar overseas transactions; the same applies hereinafter in this Subsection) by a method similar to value-at-risk; the same applies hereinafter); provided, however, that where it uses that exposure fluctuation estimation model, it shall continue to use it unless the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency is revoked.

The provisions of Article 79 apply mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that uses an exposure fluctuation estimation model. In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that Article shall be deemed to be replaced with "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".
